notes: Generates deterministic media artifacts from existing Claim-linked CarouselPlan and ReelPlan inputs; no new content claims are invented by the renderer.

Carousel output is raster PNG suitable for downstream publishing; Reel output is a provider-neutral render package consisting of deterministic storyboard PNG frames plus a timed render manifest, leaving MP4 encoding behind a replaceable renderer port.
Generated media metadata remains Workspace/Brand scoped and suitable for private object storage; public delivery URLs are a publishing concern, not domain authority.
No autonomous publishing, new AI provider, new external media-generation provider, release, deployment or production enablement is introduced.

approvals.rationale: Sazid Khan explicitly approved the next two slices and instructed completion/fixing/merge. VS-18 is the first previously presented next slice: Creative Asset Production.
FR-11/12/13/15 and the approved TRD already govern Content Assets, generated media storage, Truth/Claims, approval and deterministic publishing boundaries.
The same explicit approval authorizes bounded runtime implementation of VS-18 under PES/Loop + Superpowers/TDD.
Certification must bind the final exact 40-character candidate SHA after deterministic gates pass.
